source: AI workloads also contain both kinds of behavior. Dense matrix multiplication exposes enormous regular parallelism. Reductions require coordination. Embedding lookups may involve irregular memory access. Autoregressive serving can have small per-request work at each decode step. The same ZXNAME0000XZ can therefore be spectacularly efficient for one kernel and underutilized for the next.
zh: 人工智能工作负载也包含这两种行为。密集矩阵乘法暴露了巨大的常规并行性。削减需要协调。嵌入查找可能涉及不规则的内存访问。自回归服务在每个解码步骤中可以对每个请求进行少量工作。因此，相同的 ZXNAME0000XZ 对于一个内核来说可能非常高效，而对于下一个内核则没有得到充分利用。
